steps.step: UE in 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state sends REGISTRATION REQUEST message to AMF to initiate registration for 5GS services.
AMF may initiate 5GMM common procedures (e.g., identification, authentication, security mode control) based on the REGISTRATION REQUEST message content.
If the initial registration request is accepted by the network, the AMF sends a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message to the UE, including a TAI list.

The UE receives the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message, resets the registration attempt counter, enters the state 5GMM-REGISTERED, and sets the 5GS update status to 5U1 UPDATED. If the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message indicates a change of the network slicing information, then the UE shall return a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message.
If the AMF receives the REGISTRATION COMPLETE message, the AMF shall stop timer T3550 and enter state 5GMM-REGISTERED.
